Observe: do off-topic chunks appear in sources, does the grounded answer degrade or stay correct, does the refusal still fire or does noise clear the similarity threshold and produce a non-refusal, and do the returned sources stay within the expected document for each case.

experiments.description: Toggle app.rag.query-transformation.*/app.rag.query-expansion.* and compare retrieval breadth, answer coverage, added latency/cost, and duplicate-chunk collapsing by ConcatenationDocumentJoiner. topK and similarityThreshold are pinned across every variant so the toggle is the only moving part.

Toggle app.rag.query-transformation.compression-enabled across a genuine two-turn conversation on one shared conversationId, where turn 2 is a purely elliptical follow-up repeating no domain noun from turn 1: observe whether compression resolves turn 2 into a standalone query that retrieves the correct policy section, versus turn 2 being embedded near-verbatim with no referent when compression is off. topK and similarityThreshold are pinned across both variants so compression is the only moving part.
